title: Payroll roster and departures, January 2025 to June 2026
source_system: Payroll service portal
what_it_shows: 7 active employees by role: Founder and CEO, Head of Engineering, Firmware Engineer, Cloud Software Engineer, Verification and Test Engineer, QA/RA Manager, Operations Manager; 1 employee departure in 2025; payroll runs biweekly

title: Contract firmware developer agreement
source_system: Operations Manager's contracts folder
what_it_shows: Agreement signed in 2025 for contract firmware development; no security terms, named sponsor or account end date; the engagement ended on 2026-03-13

title: Productivity suite users, authentication and sharing settings
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: 7 named workforce accounts; MFA enforced for all users with an authenticator app; minimum password length 12 characters (MSP policy); sign-in lockout on vendor defaults; sign-in records kept; single sign-on configured to the eQMS only; shared folder links can be opened without sign-in and have no expiry by default; no backup add-on in the plan

title: Source code repository organization members and settings
source_system: Repository organization admin settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Member list with usernames, roles and last activity; MFA required for all organization members; every engineer has write access to every repository, including the release scripts; branch protection on main requires one approving review; dependency alerts on for the cloud code repositories and off for the firmware repositories; audit log of pushes, clones and permission changes on; build logs kept 90 days and readable by all members; hosted build runners; the plan includes an AI coding assistant feature that is not enabled for the organization

title: Cloud tenant identity and access export
source_system: Cloud provider console (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Named accounts for the Cloud Software Engineer and the Head of Engineering hold the owner role and are used for daily work; MFA on named accounts; one shared owner account whose MFA device is registered to the CEO's phone and whose password was last changed in 2025; no other administrator roles defined

title: Cloud tenant configuration export
source_system: Cloud provider console (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: One tenant holds development and pre-production; simulator and test data only, plus firmware images; management activity log kept for the 90-day default, with an activity log sample showing console changes; daily managed database snapshots kept 7 days in the same region, with no restore operations in the history; provider-managed encryption at rest on the database and object storage; HSM-backed key tier available with no keys created in it; TLS 1.2 minimum on the ingestion endpoint; update service stores signed hub and sensor images uploaded by hand; container images deployed without signatures; resources created in the console with no infrastructure-as-code templates; provider-managed scaling

title: eQMS users, roles, procedures and document list
source_system: eQMS and PLM admin console (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Named accounts for the 7 employees; approval rights limited to the QA/RA Manager and the CEO; QMS manual and controlled procedures for design controls, design change, risk management, document control and supplier control adopted in 2025; draft complaint procedure and draft MDR procedure (drafted by the regulatory consultant); no procedure mentions cybersecurity; no corrections and removals procedure; complaint module not yet used; design history file index started; eQMS validation record from purchase; draft instructions for use with no security section; no export of eQMS records held by the company

title: MSP device list, EDR console export and encryption report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: 7 laptops, each assigned to one employee; full-disk encryption on all 7, including the Head of Engineering's laptop; EDR agent on all 7 with alerts to the MSP; staff have no local administrator rights; remote wipe available; the list has no lab workstations, network devices, pre-production units, cloud resources or SaaS services

title: MSP monthly service report, June 2026
source_system: MSP report emailed to the Operations Manager
what_it_shows: Monthly operating system and application patching of the 7 laptops, installed on one laptop first and then the rest; EDR alerts handled by the MSP; firewall configuration backed up; the report covers the laptops, the suite and the office network only

title: Firewall and network configuration export
source_system: MSP network documentation and firewall management
what_it_shows: The firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic and exposes no services; guest Wi-Fi is a separate network with internet access only; staff Wi-Fi, the office laptops and the lab bench network share one subnet; one internet line

title: MSP service contract
source_system: Operations Manager's contracts folder
what_it_shows: Covers help desk, laptops, EDR, patching, productivity suite administration, office network and firewall, with a 4-business-hour response time; describes the remote management tool used to reach the laptops; does not cover the lab workstations, the source code repository or the cloud tenant; no recovery time commitment

title: SaaS and cloud agreements and vendor security documentation
source_system: Contracts folder; vendor websites and customer portals
what_it_shows: eQMS contract states daily platform backups by the vendor; repository, eQMS, productivity suite and cloud provider documentation describe sign-in lockout or throttling, MFA options, audit logs, TLS in transit and encryption at rest; the cloud provider publishes a shared responsibility description for PaaS; no SOC 2 report on file for the repository, eQMS or productivity suite vendors

title: Contract manufacturer quality agreement and supplier file
source_system: eQMS supplier records (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Quality agreement with the contract manufacturer covering production controls; no terms on firmware handling, provisioning secrets, test station security or security incident notice; ISO 13485 certificate on file; 2025 quality audit report with corrective actions; approved supplier list without the sensor RTOS, BLE stack or embedded Linux suppliers

title: Pilot build transfer, shipping and file sharing records
source_system: eQMS pilot build record; productivity suite sharing settings (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: 30 pre-production sets (sensor plus hub) built at the contract manufacturer in May 2026; 22 received at the company lab; 8 installed at the partner hospital's simulation center on 2026-06-15; firmware images and the hub provisioning file, which contains the hub API key, were sent through a productivity suite shared folder link that opens without sign-in and has no expiry set; shipments listed by quantity, with no list of units by serial number, location and firmware version

title: Hub and sensor security design documents and release notes
source_system: eQMS design history file (SYS-02); repository (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Hub secure boot verifies a signature at boot and before installing an update, with rollback on failure; the sensor bootloader verifies sensor images; sensors are updated through the hub; standard algorithms (TLS 1.2 or higher; signature scheme per the design); the hub logs functional events and no security events; hub alarms continue locally without the cloud; release notes list each image with no link to a reviewed commit

title: Hub configuration and interface specifications
source_system: Repository (SYS-01); eQMS design history file (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: The hub base image sets the same maintenance password on every unit; the maintenance web page is on by default on the hospital network and can view logs, change network settings and change alarm limit defaults; hubs authenticate to the cloud with one API key per environment compiled into firmware, also written in the provisioning file; sensor-to-hub BLE uses the 'Just Works' pairing method with no application-layer authentication; the hub's near-infrared camera module is disabled in WM-1 firmware

title: Design inputs, architecture diagram and engineering procedures
source_system: eQMS design history file (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Design inputs list functional and performance requirements and no security requirements; one system block diagram with no security detail; coding standard for C firmware; design change procedure with main-branch review

title: Radio link threat spreadsheet and safety risk management file
source_system: eQMS design history file (SYS-02); engineering shared folder
what_it_shows: The threat spreadsheet covers the sensor-to-hub radio link only; the safety risk management file lists hazards from device function and no security causes; no separate cybersecurity risk assessment was provided

title: Third-party software component spreadsheet
source_system: Engineering shared folder
what_it_shows: Lists the hub's embedded Linux distribution, the sensor RTOS, the BLE stack, a TLS library and open-source libraries by name; no versions, support status or end-of-support dates; no machine-readable SBOM

title: Verification plan, records, CI test results and anomaly list
source_system: eQMS (SYS-02); CI service (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Verification plan covers functional and performance requirements; unit tests run in CI on every change; signed verification records traced to requirements; anomaly list with status and owner and no security field; no static analysis, fuzzing or penetration test records

title: Third-party penetration test quote
source_system: Verification and Test Engineer's email
what_it_shows: Quote from a test lab for a penetration test of the WM-1 system (sensor, hub, cloud service, update path) with one retest, about $28,000, planned for 2026-12

title: Regulatory strategy memo
source_system: eQMS regulatory file (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Prepared by the regulatory consultant: WM-1 is expected to be class II with a 510(k) against an identified predicate; records WM-1 as a cyber device (firmware in the sensor and hub, Wi-Fi and BLE connectivity, a cloud update path); no exemption under 524B(d) identified; no clinical investigation planned; target submission date 2027-03-31; pre-submission request planned for 2026-11

title: FDA premarket guidance checklist and submission project plan
source_system: eQMS regulatory file (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Checklist against FDA's premarket cybersecurity guidance (issued 2026-02-03) about 20% complete; no cybersecurity section of the 510(k) drafted; project plan with the 2027-03-31 submission date

title: Policies folder and document request response
source_system: Document request list; shared drive
what_it_shows: A two-page MSP 'IT rules' sheet signed at hire, which tells staff not to share or write down passwords; the request for security policies, an incident response plan, a product security incident procedure, a cybersecurity management plan, a CVD policy, a patch or update procedure, a contingency plan, a system threat model, an SBOM and an asset inventory returned none

title: Training records
source_system: eQMS training records (SYS-02); MSP video completion list
what_it_shows: All 7 employees completed the MSP onboarding security video at hire; no annual security training, phishing exercise or secure coding course is recorded

title: Offboarding emails, 2025 and 2026
source_system: Operations Manager's mailbox (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Departures are handled by an email from the Operations Manager to the MSP asking it to disable the suite account; the emails do not mention repository, eQMS, cloud or lab accounts; no offboarding checklist

title: Cyber liability and product liability insurance policies
source_system: Operations Manager's contracts folder
what_it_shows: Cyber liability policy bought in April 2026 at an investor's request: 24x7 breach hotline; panel vendors (breach counsel, forensics); notice through the hotline required before outside firms are hired; limited coverage of product-related incidents at customers. A separate product liability policy is on file

title: Development and evaluation agreement with the partner hospital system
source_system: Operations Manager's contracts folder
what_it_shows: Paid development and evaluation agreement; 8 evaluation units at the hospital's clinical simulation center on its isolated test network, which the hospital's security team monitors; test data only and no patient connection; notice of incidents affecting the evaluation units within 72 hours; contacts for the simulation center manager and the hospital security team; a post-clearance clinical pilot is planned

title: Partner hospital vendor security questionnaire
source_system: Operations Manager's email inbox (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Vendor security review questionnaire from the partner hospital system, organized by the Trust Services Criteria; response due 2026-10-30

title: Financial report: FY2025 receipts and 2026 operating cost
source_system: Accounting SaaS (outside bookkeeper)
what_it_shows: FY2025 receipts of about $1.1 million, mostly from the partner hospital development and evaluation agreement; monthly operating cost about $190,000 (about $8,600 per business day), funded mainly by seed investment; cash runway about 14 months

title: Company card statements and vendor invoices, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: Company credit card statements; accounting SaaS
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the source code and CI service vendor, the eQMS vendor, the productivity suite vendor, the cloud provider, the MSP, the payroll service, the accounting SaaS, the cyber and product liability insurers, the regulatory consultant and the contract manufacturer; no charges from AI tool vendors; no ISAO membership fee

title: Office and lab walk-through and equipment count
source_system: Office suite and engineering lab (observation)
what_it_shows: 7 laptops and 2 lab workstations counted; the lab workstations sign in with one shared local login, show no EDR agent, have disk encryption off, accept remote desktop connections from the office network, and hold test data and copies of the hub provisioning file; they are used to flash units and run bench tests; 22 pre-production sets in the lab; lab bench network cabled to the office switch; keyed suite entry with an after-hours alarm; an office safe holding an encrypted USB drive; one office suite

title: Office key list and lease security terms
source_system: Operations Manager's files
what_it_shows: Suite keys held by the CEO and the Operations Manager; the lease states the building is locked after hours with badge entry run by the landlord

title: Intake interview: engineering systems and release process
source_system: Interview (Head of Engineering, Cloud Software Engineer)
what_it_shows: Release images are built in CI, downloaded to the Head of Engineering's laptop and signed there with a password-protected key file; a copy of the key is on an encrypted USB drive in the office safe; only the Head of Engineering signs, with no HSM and no second approval; images are uploaded to the update service by hand from the laptop; cloud changes are made in the console; the shared cloud owner password is known to the CEO and the Cloud Software Engineer; repository and cloud accounts are added on request in chat; nobody reviews repository, cloud or suite logs; nobody monitors vulnerabilities in sensor or hub components; the company is not an ISAO member; only the Cloud Software Engineer administers the cloud tenant

title: Staff AI tool survey
source_system: Short questionnaire to all 7 employees
what_it_shows: Engineers report pasting code snippets into public generative AI chatbots through personal accounts; the survey did not record how often or what was entered; AI-001 feasibility work is reported by the Head of Engineering; no list of approved AI tools exists in the documents provided

title: AI-001 training dataset license and documentation
source_system: Head of Engineering's files; engineering shared folder
what_it_shows: License from a university lab for about 60 hours of video of 120 adult volunteers aged 19 to 45, faces visible, with chest-band reference respiratory rate and no demographic labels; no counsel review of the license terms is on file; copies held on one engineer's laptop and in a shared folder

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (Head of Engineering, QA/RA Manager, Cloud Software Engineer, Verification and Test Engineer, Operations Manager, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate; the Head of Engineering estimates that losing the signing key would mean re-keying all units and repeating a pilot build, about $60,000 and 6 weeks; raw test data is uploaded to the eQMS daily; no pilot build is scheduled before 2027 Q1

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past events and near misses; changes to supplier bank details are accepted by email with no call-back step; laptops travel with staff; the MSP lead technician states that MSP technicians use MFA on the remote management platform, with no supporting record supplied

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (Head of Engineering, Firmware Engineer, Cloud Software Engineer, Verification and Test Engineer, QA/RA Manager, regulatory consultant)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each section 524B, QMSR and guidance element is handled today: nobody monitors vulnerabilities in WM-1 components; there is no out-of-cycle release procedure and only one person can sign a release; security work depends on individual engineers with no written framework; the Firmware Engineer describes 'Just Works' BLE pairing with no application-layer protection

title: Build and release walk-through and website review
source_system: Head of Engineering's laptop; office safe; engineering lab; company website (observation)
what_it_shows: The signing key is a password-protected file on the Head of Engineering's laptop, with an encrypted USB copy in the office safe; the 2 lab workstations sign in with one shared local login; the company website has a general contact form that reaches the CEO and no security contact or vulnerability disclosure page

title: Cloud provider SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Cloud provider compliance portal (under NDA)
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on Security, Availability and Confidentiality for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31 with an unqualified opinion; 2 exceptions (a late removal of an operator's access, 1 of 40 sampled; a change deployed without a recorded approval, 1 of 60 sampled), both remediated; all six services the company uses are in scope, including the HSM-backed key tier; data center colocation providers in some regions carved out; complementary user entity controls listed; no bridge letter provided

title: Evaluation hub configuration change and notice to the partner hospital
source_system: Head of Engineering's email to the partner hospital security team
what_it_shows: The maintenance page was disabled by configuration on the 8 evaluation hubs on 2026-08-14, and the partner hospital's security team was told the same day

title: Control assessment: account management test
source_system: Suite user export; repository member list and audit log; eQMS user list; cloud identity list; staff and contractor roster; contractor end dates; Operations Manager and Cloud Software Engineer interviews
what_it_shows: Account types, approvals, procedures and reviews are not documented; every engineer has write access to every repository; a shared cloud owner account and a shared lab login are in use; the former firmware contractor's repository account still had write access on 2026-08-11, about 5 months after the engagement ended on 2026-03-13, and was removed that day; the repository audit log shows no pushes or clones by that account after 2026-03-13; current employees' accounts match their job family on the roster; offboarding covers the suite only

title: Control assessment: privileged MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Suite, repository and cloud MFA settings; sign-in attempts to the cloud owner account and the firewall management page with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: MFA is enforced for named suite, repository and cloud accounts; the shared cloud owner account's second factor is on the CEO's phone and codes are read out to the Cloud Software Engineer; the firewall management login accepted a password alone

title: Control assessment: signing key custody review
source_system: Signing key file and backup USB drive (existence only; key not copied); release notes; Head of Engineering interview; key management service settings
what_it_shows: The signing key was generated on a laptop in 2025 with no documented requirements, parameters or witness; one custodian; no two-person control, rotation or revocation plan; one USB backup in the office safe, never restored; the device certificate authority is not established; the HSM-backed key tier is unused

title: Control assessment: authenticator tests
source_system: Hub base image configuration; CI build logs; provisioning file; lab test of 2 hubs; MSP IT rules sheet
what_it_shows: The default maintenance password was accepted on both lab hubs tested, and the hub base image sets the same password on every unit; the hub API key appeared in plain text in CI build logs readable by all repository members, printed by a debug step (the step was removed and the logs purged on 2026-08-12); the API key is in the provisioning file and stored unencrypted in the hub configuration, read through the debug serial port of a lab unit; the cloud owner password is unchanged since 2025 and the API key has never been rotated; no procedure exists to revoke one hub's credential; workforce passwords are at least 12 characters with MFA; the MSP IT rules sheet signed at hire tells staff not to share passwords

title: Control assessment: component inventory review
source_system: MSP laptop list; component spreadsheet; pre-production unit shipping records; cloud resource list; Head of Engineering interview
what_it_shows: The only inventory is the MSP's list of 7 laptops, with no duplicates; lab workstations, network devices, the 30 pre-production units, cloud resources and software components are not listed; owner, location and firmware version are not recorded for the units, 8 of which are at the partner hospital; no SBOM; no review frequency

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring review and spot check
source_system: Repository dependency alert settings and open alerts; component spreadsheet; Head of Engineering interview; 3 hub components checked against public vulnerability databases
what_it_shows: Dependency alerts identify cloud code flaws by CVE identifier and update automatically; 14 alerts older than 90 days have not been analyzed; sensor and hub components are not monitored; no scanning of the cloud tenant, hubs or lab workstations; no severity scoring or remediation time frames; no CVD channel or ISAO membership; the hub's TLS library version has published vulnerabilities not yet assessed

title: Control assessment: developer testing review
source_system: Verification plan and reports; CI test results; anomaly list in the eQMS; Verification and Test Engineer interview
what_it_shows: Unit tests run in CI on every change and system verification runs on lab units; results are recorded as pass or fail and traced to requirements; anomalies are tracked with status and owner, and 5 of 5 sampled anomalies were corrected and retested before closure; no security or privacy assessment plan

title: Control assessment: secure boot and update integrity test
source_system: Secure boot design; modified images loaded onto 2 hubs and 2 sensors; update service configuration; contract manufacturer transfer record
what_it_shows: Hub secure boot detected a modified software image and the hub booted the previous signed image; the sensor bootloader rejected a modified firmware image and kept its current firmware; no integrity check on release images in the update service, the shared-link transfer to the contract manufacturer or hub configuration data; no action defined for unauthorized configuration changes

title: Control assessment: backup review
source_system: Cloud snapshot settings; eQMS contract; suite plan description; signing key backup location; Cloud Software Engineer interview
what_it_shows: Daily cloud database snapshots kept 7 days in the same region as the service and encrypted by the provider; no company-held export of the eQMS; no backup of productivity suite content beyond the vendor's own resilience; no restore or integrity check has been done; the signing key backup is an encrypted USB drive in the same office as the laptop

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation review and test
source_system: MSP patch report (July 2026) and patch policy; operating system version check on 2 lab workstations and 2 laptops; firewall firmware record; open dependency alerts
what_it_shows: The MSP tool identifies and reports missing laptop patches monthly and installs patches on one laptop before the rest; both lab workstations were 14 months behind on operating system updates; 14 dependency alerts open; laptop and firewall firmware updates are applied without a test step; no time frames defined for security updates

title: Control assessment: supply chain review
source_system: Supplier control procedure; contract manufacturer quality agreement and 2025 audit report; pilot build transfer record (supplied 2026-08-07); QA/RA Manager interview
what_it_shows: The supplier control procedure evaluates suppliers, audits the contract manufacturer and raises corrective actions on quality topics; the quality agreement has no security terms or incident notice; secrets were sent by a shared link with no expiry; security topics are not coordinated with the contract manufacturer or software suppliers

title: Control assessment: personnel termination review
source_system: Offboarding emails for 2025 and 2026 departures; contractor agreement; Operations Manager interview
what_it_shows: No time limit for disabling access; the contractor's repository access lasted about 5 months after the engagement ended; the shared API key the contractor could see was not rotated; no exit discussion of confidentiality; the one 2025 employee departure returned the laptop and office keys; departed people's work remains accessible in the repository and eQMS

title: Control assessment: incident response plan review
source_system: Draft P08 runbook and notification matrix (version of 2026-08-07); Head of Engineering and Operations Manager interviews
what_it_shows: The draft runbook sets out preparation, detection, response and recovery steps; names roles and backups, including the MSP and the insurer; defines declaration triggers and severity levels; links to the QMS and to corporate IT response; addresses information sharing; has no response metrics or resource commitments; was not approved, distributed or tested at fieldwork; and is kept in the eQMS with access limited to employees
